title: Hymn and Smile
author: Petra Kavanagh
blurb: Wren Winterbourne, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
